title: Adolescent Safety, Consent & Healthy Relationships (Youth Track)
description: SS-CRS-PAR-006 & Youth Track: Supports adolescents and parents in navigating healthy peer and dating relationships, consent, digital boundaries, online safety, and emotional independence during family change.
outcomes: Recognise the signs of respectful vs. controlling or unhealthy dating and peer relationships
Maintain strong digital boundaries, online consent, and protection against image-based abuse or coercion
Build healthy coping strategies for family stress, emotional independence, and help-seeking
